newsitem.title: NORWAY: Leif Hoegh calls extraordinary meeting.
newsitem.headline: Leif Hoegh calls extraordinary meeting.

text.p: Norwegian shipping company Leif Hoegh & Co said on Monday it would hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to discuss an extraordinary dividend in connection with the group's stake in Bona Shipholding Ltd.
The meeting will take place on July 15 at 1500 GMT.
Leif Hoegh said its board recommended the payment of an extraordinary dividend of about 200 million crowns in the form of Bona Shipholding (BSH) shares.
The dividend would be paid by distributing one BSH share for each shareholdidng of 12 shares in Leigh Hoeegh and a cash settlement for individual and excess shareholdings of fewer than 12 shares.

Leif Hoegh added that as a result of its large stake -- about 42.3 percent -- in Bona, the liquidity of BSH shares was limited, but it expected the investment in BSH to have an upside potential in the long term.
It said it would therefore propose the distribution of up to 2.5 million BSH shares to Leif Hoegh shareholders, thereby reducing the company's stake in Bona to 33.5 percent.
Leif Hoegh said the meeting also would vote on a reduction of the number of board members to six from seven.
